description:
We are a team of five engineering students: Aneena S S, Jerin and Nandana (3rd-year CSE), Abhinav (3rd-year ECE), and Akhila (1st-year ECE).
Our project is an interactive digital storytelling platform that explores the spacecraft, abandoned equipment, mission remnants, and lost communications left across the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
Through interactive visualizations, spacecraft profiles, mission histories, 3D experiences, and historical timelines.
